player_prompt.intro:
I ye jokelani {player_id} o kɔnɔ Wild Tic Tac Toe.
O tɛmɛnɛn, i bɛ se dɛmɛ 'X' waati 'O' kɔnɔ kɔnɔ dɛmɛ.
I ye sɛgɛn o taa dɛmɛ kɔnɔ kɛnɛyan (X waati O) kɔnɔ dɛmɛ.
I bɛ se sɛgɛn o taa simbɔli dɔ.
Dɛmɛ sira kɔnɔ '[X 4]' masada o dɛmɛ X kɔnɔ kɔnɔ dɛmɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Use '[X 4]' or '[O 2]' format.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Sɛli man ɲi: {cell}. A ka kan ka kɛ 0 ni 8 cɛ.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Invalid move. Cell {cell} is already occupied.

game_action.placed: Jokelani {player_id} daa dɛmɛ so simbɔli ({mark}) kɔnɔ {cell}

outcome.draw: U bɛɛ bɛnna a la ko an tɛna bɔnɛ foyi sɔrɔ.
